overview: This House resolution sets the debate rules for two bills. The first, H.R. 276, would rename the Gulf of Mexico as the "Gulf of America" in federal use; the second, H.R. 881, would restrict Department of Homeland Security funding for colleges and universities that have ties to Confucius Institutes, which are Chinese government-backed language and culture programs. For each bill, the resolution allows one hour of debate split between the leaders of the relevant committee, sets aside procedural objections, swaps in an updated version of the bill text, and allows one motion to send the bill back to committee. It does not itself rename anything or change any funding. The House adopted it on May 6, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution provides an orderly way for the House to debate and vote on two bills that committees have already reviewed.
against: Critics say the resolution limits debate to one hour per bill and blocks amendments from the floor, leaving members little chance to change either bill.
